scope: Internal sealed host template, pure signed command realization and read-only fixture eligibility. No authoritative host registry, reservation, allocation, runtime admission, actual asset verification or full-topology execution.

plan.policy: Fixed frontend limits match the prior native fixture. Memory limits are conservative envelopes, not measured usage or performance guarantees.
plan.placement: Native replicas only on their fleet; MinIO/controller/gateway reach private networks. Only ingress attaches frontend and publishes a loopback port. Frontend authority/input mounts are read-only and no storage credential environment is supplied.
plan.identity: Engine/preparation namespace, immutable image, unique canonical browser origin and asset fingerprints bind the sealed template. Actual deadline derives only from the original signed execution grant.
plan.configurationFingerprint: Canonical sealed template hash, not a hash of a separately mutable realized Docker JSON file. Actual physical graph must be checked independently.

eligibility.namespace: Retained resources and declared ports refuse reuse; current and held subnets must be available.
eligibility.memory: All active/paused/restarting container limits count; unknown active limits refuse. Complete supplied holds stay budgeted after containers stop.
eligibility.credit: One known active role may cover its held budget only with matching name, image, project/config/role labels. Unrelated containers and duplicate holds cannot consume that credit.
eligibility.snapshot: Complete container/network/volume IDs are rechecked after inspection and engine binding must stay stable. This is not a lock and no capacity is reserved.

checks.standardsSelfReview: PASS; all ten dimensions assessed; no external reviewer
checks.fullSuite: Not run for this change; connected tests only

actualHostFixture.scope: Read-only host snapshot and supplied planning inputs; no actual artifact/TLS verification, host hold registry, reservation, allocation, execution or catalog admission.

independentReadback.scope: Independent readback of sealed metadata plan and read-only fixture snapshot; no runtime admission, reservation or execution.
independentReadback.fixtureInputsOnly: No authoritative reservation registry, artifact or TLS verification; held plans are explicitly supplied fixture data.

knownQualityFailure.observed: Initial inventory validator newly reached CCN16.
knownQualityFailure.correction: Extracted resource-shape checks; final gate passes without threshold/baseline edits.

limits: Actual check uses explicit fixture fingerprints/holds. It does not verify artifact/TLS bytes or prove an authoritative reservation registry is empty.
Host locking, durable reservation/enrollment, independently admitted runtime and complete stopped-graph verification remain required before any effects.
Other actors can change resources or ports after a snapshot; admission is eligibility only, not a reservation or performance guarantee.
Full topology execution, ordered teardown, complete browser/app-update trials and public lifecycle commands remain open.
All 75 prior QA containers remain nonrunning and unchanged; no resource or workload was created. Existing networks/volumes are preserved.
